title: A Small World

pre.en: Who was the old lady's grandson?

intro: 一篇新概念式的小故事：Chen 第一次飞去柏林见远程团队，一路紧张得不行，偏偏碰上一位特别能聊的邻座老太太。读的时候留意说将来的几种把握：will definitely、will probably、may、might——人一紧张就爱预测，预测得准不准，结尾见分晓。

sentences.en: Last month I flew to Berlin to meet my remote team for the first time.
sentences.zh: 上个月，我飞去柏林，第一次跟远程团队的同事见面。

sentences.en: I was so nervous about it that I couldn't sleep the night before.
sentences.zh: 我紧张得前一天晚上都没睡着。

sentences.en: On the plane, I kept thinking: they'll probably hate my accent, and I might forget everyone's names.
sentences.zh: 在飞机上，我脑子里一直在想：他们多半会嫌弃我的口音，我说不定还会把大家的名字全忘了。

sentences.en: And I definitely won't sleep on this plane.
sentences.zh: 而且这一路我肯定睡不着。

sentences.en: Then the old lady next to me struck up a conversation: "Have you ever been to Berlin?"
sentences.zh: 这时，邻座的老太太跟我搭起话来：「你去过柏林吗？」

sentences.en: I'm terrible at making small talk, but she didn't need any help.
sentences.zh: 我最不会跟人寒暄，可她根本用不着我帮忙。

sentences.en: She could talk for hours, and she did.
sentences.zh: 她能一口气聊好几个小时——她也真就聊了好几个小时。

sentences.en: It turned out we had a lot in common.
sentences.zh: 结果发现我们俩还挺合得来。

sentences.en: We both loved noodles and terrible films.
sentences.zh: 都爱吃面，都爱看烂片。

sentences.en: Once, her car broke down on her wedding day.
sentences.zh: 有一回，她结婚那天车坏在了半路。

sentences.en: So a farmer took her to the church on his tractor — for free.
sentences.zh: 结果一个农民开着拖拉机把她送到了教堂——一分钱没要。

sentences.en: Her stories were so funny that, to my surprise, I forgot to be nervous.
sentences.zh: 她的故事太好笑了，没想到，我连紧张都忘了。

sentences.en: Anyway, she showed me dozens of photos of her grandson.
sentences.zh: 后来，她给我看了几十张她孙子的照片。

sentences.en: She was clearly proud of him.
sentences.zh: 看得出来，她特别为这个孙子骄傲。

sentences.en: By coincidence, he was a software engineer in Berlin too.
sentences.zh: 巧的是，他也是软件工程师，也在柏林。

sentences.en: "You may not like the weather, but you'll love Berlin," she said.
sentences.zh: 「柏林的天气你可能不喜欢，但这座城市你一定会爱上，」她说。

sentences.en: "And my grandson will definitely show you around."
sentences.zh: 「我孙子肯定会带你到处转转。」

sentences.en: Somewhere in the middle of her fourth story, I nodded off.
sentences.zh: 她讲到第四个故事的时候，我不知不觉睡着了。

sentences.en: At arrivals, Jonas from my team was waiting with a sign that said "Chen".
sentences.zh: 到达大厅里，团队的 Jonas 举着写着「Chen」的牌子在等我。

sentences.en: Before I could say hello, the old lady ran past me and hugged him.
sentences.zh: 我还没来得及打招呼，老太太就从我身边冲过去，一把抱住了他。

sentences.en: "My grandson!"
sentences.zh: 「大孙子！」

sentences.en: It's a small world, I thought.
sentences.zh: 世界真小，我心想。

sentences.en: "She's already shown me thirty photos of you," I told him.
sentences.zh: 「她已经给我看过你三十张照片了，」我跟他说。

cards.note: remote team 远程团队；work remotely 远程办公。
to feel worried and a little afraid about something that is going to happen
cards.tip: 第 13 课是 I'm so nervous about tomorrow；这里和 so … that 连用，说紧张到什么地步：连觉都睡不着。
cards.example: Are you nervous about the presentation tomorrow?

cards.note: a strong accent 口音很重；重音在前：AC-cent。

cards.zh: （和陌生人）攀谈起来；搭起话来
cards.note: to start talking to someone you don't know
cards.tip: strike 的过去式是 struck；跟谁搭话用 with：strike up a conversation with sb。
cards.example: I struck up a conversation with a designer at the conference.

cards.note: to have a polite conversation about unimportant things, especially with people you don't know well
cards.tip: be terrible at / good at 后面接 doing：good at making small talk。
cards.example: We made small talk about the weather until the meeting started.

cards.note: to happen in a way you did not expect, or to be discovered to be true
to share many of the same interests, opinions or experiences
cards.tip: 后面常用冒号或破折号列出共同点；第 11 课学过，这里换成了飞机上的陌生人。
cards.example: My new manager and I have a lot in common — we both started as designers.

cards.note: to stop working, used about machines and cars
坐交通工具用 on：on his tractor、on the bus；小汽车用 in：in a car。
without having to pay, or without being paid
used to say that something was not what you expected
to feel pleased and satisfied about something you have done or own
放在 be 动词后面，表示「一看就知道」；也有「清楚地」的意思：speak clearly。
by chance, in a surprising way that was not planned
cards.tip: 也可以说 by chance；感叹「真巧！」说 What a coincidence!
cards.example: By coincidence, my new colleague went to the same university as me.

cards.zh: 带某人参观；带某人四处转转
cards.note: to take someone to see the different parts of a place
cards.tip: 人放在 show 和 around 中间：show you around；带着参观哪里直接接地点：show sb around the city。
cards.example: On my first day, my manager showed me around the office.

cards.note: during something, or at the centre of a place
cards.tip: 既能说地方（in the middle of the room），也能说事情进行到一半（in the middle of dinner）。
cards.example: My phone rang in the middle of the meeting.

cards.note: to fall asleep without meaning to, especially when sitting
cards.tip: 比 fall asleep 口语，常指坐着不小心睡着；过去式要双写 d：nodded off。
cards.example: I nodded off on the train and missed my stop.

cards.note: 机场里的 arrivals 到达区，departures 出发区，两个词都用复数。
过去式双写 g：hugged；名词也是 hug：give sb a hug。
used when you are surprised to meet someone you know, or to find a connection with someone, in an unexpected place
cards.tip: 碰到意想不到的巧合时说的感叹，基本就用这一种说法，不说 The world is small。
cards.example: You know my old boss too? It's a small world!
